## Definition of ready
- [ ] Persona is a named role, not "the user"
- [ ] The "so that" is a real outcome, not a restatement of the feature
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is pass/fail
- [ ] Describes the outcome, not the implementation
- [ ] Fits one dev, one PR; dependencies on other issues are linked
- [ ] Reference material (screens, docs, source files) is linked
